wins: Captured initial web crawl data within the first five minutes, confirming exposed management interfaces on the target.
Collected reusable credential hints from HTTP responses that can inform future lateral movement attempts.
fails: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed because the available SUID binaries were not further investigated.
Network pivoting stalled due to missing route discovery, preventing access to critical internal segments.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance assets were gathered swiftly, but follow-through on privilege escalation and lateral movement never materialized, leaving the mission incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeatedly stopped short of exploiting identified SUID binaries, leaving local privilege escalation unexplored.

skill_cards.if_condition: When an HTTP service responds with a login page and custom X-Source header
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted gobuster/fuzzing plus nikto for hidden directories and header anomalies

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and non-standard banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Execute banner-aware ssh enumeration with ssh-audit and user enumeration scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When local enumeration shows SUID binaries without documented justification
skill_cards.then_action: Run ltrace/strace on suspicious binaries and search for writable inputs before attempting exploitation

memory_ops.reason: Consistently collected actionable portal details during initial reconnaissance
Identified SUID binaries quickly but never fully exploited—promote to emphasize follow-up
